name: Job post applicants
oneLiner: a white job post card lands on a warm lit desk: the company mark, the role set big, its chips and a live Hiring dot; the applicants counter climbs fast while applicant avatars drop onto a stack one by one, a +N disc closes the stack and a green today chip stamps on
say: when the speaker says they posted a role and people flooded in ('I posted one job and 400 people applied', 'we are hiring'): cut in on the role, the counter lands on the number they say
